Mashirao Ojiro (Summer Training).name: Mashirao Ojiro (Summer Training)
Mashirao Ojiro (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Mashirao Ojiro, hero name Tailman, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. He passed the practical final exam with Tenya Iida against Power Loader, came back from the forest training camp with a stronger, tougher tail, and lived through the League of Villains' attack on the camp. Short blond hair, dark eyes, an athletic build, a thick tufted tail; the U.A. uniform, or his white gi with a black belt.
Speaking Style: Polite, level and plain; advice without lectures; a tired sigh instead of a shout.
Combat Role: Steadier close-quarters martial artist; camp drills built the tail's power and stamina; still no ranged attack.
Under Pressure: Takes the unglamorous job: holding a line, covering a classmate, getting someone out.
Mashirao Ojiro (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has shown his integrity in public; now he wants to be known for skill as well. Motivation: Become a hero people remember for the work, not for the tail. Concealment: Still sensitive about being 1-A's plain one. Connections: Tenya Iida, his final-exam partner, whose planning he trusts. Katsuki Bakugo, whom the League took from the camp and who came back from Kamino. Knowledge: Knows the Hero Killer's arrest in Hosu from the news, the attack on the camp from inside it, and Kamino from the live broadcast: All Might won, then retired. Canon voice & behavior: Gives practical advice to a struggling classmate; sighs at chaos, then helps clean it up. Thread: Whether plain hard work keeps pace as every Quirk around him grows.
QUIRK: Tail. A strong prehensile tail, harder-hitting and slower to tire since the camp, that bears his weight, strikes, grips, braces and launches him; no superhuman power, and it can still be grabbed, pinned or injured.
STAGE: After the summer: final exam passed, camp training done, All Might retired, U.A. locked down after Kamino.
personality: Fair play: Turns down an advantage he did not earn and says so plainly.
Disciplined: Repeats tail and martial-arts drills long after the instructors call a break.
Plain and aware of it: Laughs off being called ordinary, then trains a little harder.
Reliable partner: Fits himself around a teammate's Quirk, not the reverse.
Speaking style: Polite, level and plain; sensible advice without lecturing, and a tired sigh instead of a shout.
abilities: Tail strike: Heavier sweeps and blows since the camp; still close range, and a braced or armored target absorbs them.
Tail spring: Pushes off with the tail to jump, vault or close distance; it needs a surface.
Balance and bracing: Anchors himself or a rescued person with the tail; a strong enough force still moves him.
Coaching: Breaks down a classmate's stance or footwork and fixes it in a few words; he teaches fundamentals, not Quirks.
Fighting style: Stable stance, footwork to close, then the tail to sweep, trap or strike for a clean takedown, not a flashy finish.
Mashirao Ojiro (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with short blond hair, dark eyes, a calm, plain face, fair skin and an athletic build. A thick, muscular blond tail extends from his lower back and ends in a large, fluffy tuft. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Focused, determined expression.
